study_identification_part.si_4_title: Characterizing the distinct imaging phenotypes, clinical behavior, and genetic vulnerability of brain maturational subtypes in mood disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Single-site cohorts from the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University (discovery dataset 1; replication dataset 2).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "All the patients were recruited from the inpatient department of the Shenyang Mental Health Center and the outpatient clinic of the Department of Psychiatry of the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University, Shenyang, China."; "These patients were also recruited and scanned at the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Zheng2024.pdf.md: Methods, Paragraph 1; Zheng2024.pdf.md: Methods, Paragraph 1

answer.SINGLE-SITE: Dataset 1 (discovery cohort) used to build HC-based normative curves and subtype patients; Dataset 2 (replication cohort) used to validate GMV deviations/subtyping.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Discovery dataset (174 drug-free patients + 404 HC) for normative modeling and subtyping; replication dataset (268 medicated patients) for validation.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we used quantile regression model and created normative curves with age based on GMV in HC group and calculated individual deviations for each region"; "In this study, the 174 drugfree patients constitute the discovery dataset (dataset 1), while the 268 medicated patients comprise the validated dataset (dataset 2)."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Zheng2024.pdf.md: Figure 1 caption; Zheng2024.pdf.md: GMV normative deviation calculation and subtypes clustering

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: HC sample size reported for Dataset 1; no train/validation split described, so train equals overall HC count.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "We recruited 174 drug-naïve and drug-free patients with major depressive disorder and bipolar disorder, as well as 404 healthy controls."; "Clinical and Demographic Data | N=404"
